name: 5N Plus Inc.
blurb: 5N Plus Inc. (TSX: VNP) is a Montreal-based producer of ultra-high-purity specialty semiconductors and performance materials, operating in two segments. Specialty Semiconductors manufactures compound semiconductor wafers, epitaxial substrates, and advanced materials — principally from tellurium, germanium, indium, gallium, bismuth, and selenium — for applications in space solar cells, defence infrared sensors, and compound semiconductor devices. Performance Materials supplies bismuth and other high-purity metals for pharmaceutical, industrial, and energy applications. The company's German subsidiary, AZUR SPACE, is one of the world's leading manufacturers of space-grade multi-junction solar cells for satellite programmes, with production capacity expanded roughly 30% in 2025 and a further 25% expansion planned for the second half of 2026. 5N Plus appeared as a named competitor in Coherent Corp.'s 2022 10-K filing when shares traded near C$0.92; by mid-2026 the stock had reached C$35–36, a gain of roughly 38x.
recent: Full-year 2025 results featured 35% revenue growth and 73% higher Adjusted EBITDA, following record 2024 results (revenue up 19% to $289M, EBITDA up 39% to $53M). In February 2026 the company announced another 25% expansion of AZUR SPACE solar-cell capacity. The 52-week range as of May 2026 is C$5.12–C$36.40, with the stock having outperformed the TSX Composite by roughly 342 percentage points over the prior twelve months. The analyst consensus is Buy, with a target near C$37.65.
